### Controller Design Summary
1. **Real-Time Rotational & Translational Disturbance Observers**:
   - Tracks the inner attitude loop's state (`simIntRoll`, `simIntPitch`) and estimates rotational torque biases (`bRoll`, `bPitch`) caused by the hidden weak motor, inverting the inner loop to achieve fast, critically damped attitude tracking without integral-clamp offset.

3. **Soft Landing & Active Pinned Floor Hold**:
   - Maintains a safe hover cushion ($y \ge 0.22\text{ m}$) with full attitude authority when strong gusts over the pad demand high tilt, descending to touchdown only when tilt and horizontal speed are within safe floor-contact bounds.
   - Uses a light positive collective thrust on the pad so all four motors remain in their linear regime while gravity pins the airframe to $y = 0.07\text{ m}$ under floor damping, holding tilt strictly below $0.18\text{ rad}$.

I have set up the harness tools and built the flight controller in `controller.js`.

### Controller Design Summary
1. **Real-Time Rotational & Translational Disturbance Observers**:
   - Tracks the inner attitude loop's state (`simIntRoll`, `simIntPitch`) and estimates rotational torque biases (`bRoll`, `bPitch`) caused by the hidden weak motor, inverting the inner loop to achieve fast, critically damped attitude tracking without integral-clamp offset.
   - Estimates the effective specific thrust scale (`kT`) online from vertical motion (where vertical wind is zero) and uses the measured 3D attitude direction to separate applied thrust acceleration from horizontal wind and gust accelerations (`wxHat`, `wzHat`), plus baseline wind (`wxBase`, `wzBase`) estimated during the initial gust-free window ($t < 2.0\text{ s}$).
2. **Gate Alignment & Crossing Guard**:
   - Aligns tightly at a standoff point ($0.24\text{ m}$ in front of each gate plane) and verifies both current and predicted crossing clearance in $y$ and $z$ as well as lateral gust transients before lunging through the $0.42\text{ m}$ gate opening.
   - Aborts a lunge back to the standoff position if an abrupt gust perturbs predicted crossing alignment while still outside the stopping distance.
3. **Soft Landing & Active Pinned Floor Hold**:
   - Maintains a safe hover cushion ($y \ge 0.22\text{ m}$) with full attitude authority when strong gusts over the pad demand high tilt, descending to touchdown only when tilt and horizontal speed are within safe floor-contact bounds.
   - Uses a light positive collective thrust on the pad so all four motors remain in their linear regime while gravity pins the airframe to $y = 0.07\text{ m}$ under floor damping, holding tilt strictly below $0.18\text{ rad}$.
